planets.name: HAT-P-15 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-15 with a 10.9-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-15 b was found in 2010 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-15. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
